forbidden.name: core-module-facade-only
forbidden.comment: A core module uses another only through that module's index.ts; never its models, collections or inside files (ARCHITECTURE §4, RULES §4.2). Side effects go by outbox events.

forbidden.name: core-no-other-deployable
forbidden.comment: Core never imports another deployable's code (identity, payments, notify, gateway, bundle): they talk by HTTP contracts and events, and in bundle mode this keeps their secrets apart (ARCHITECTURE §3).
